narrative: In the glass. Shakespeare looks straight out of it. His own place is an empty oval, marked W. S.

entities.name: Gilbert Shakespeare
entities.context: Named himself and St Bride's, brought the Stratford news, and named the twenty-sixth.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said you eat, agreed to fetch, and admitted you had forgot the day.

entities.name: the glass
entities.context: Shown on glass in In the glass with Shakespeare
